description: Hand control to the human for something automation must not or cannot do — CAPTCHAs, anti-bot 'verify you're human' walls, 2FA approvals, or a deliberate judgment call. Sends a desktop notification and returns a message you should relay to the user, then STOP and wait for them to act before continuing. Do not attempt to bypass CAPTCHAs yourself.

message.description: What you need the human to do, e.g. 'Solve the CAPTCHA on the login page, then tell me to continue.'

name: browser_request_human_help
